Mage — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM: A vast double-layered blue-and-silver geometric spell-circle erupts across the hall floor, its outer ring still expanding toward the walls as the inner rune-segments ignite in sequential arcs. RUNIC STORM — ARCHMAGE: Hundreds of blazing blue-and-silver runes erupt in a towering vortex around the archmage, his robes whipping violently in the magical wind, hair streaming upward. SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM — CLERIC: A vast geometric spell-circle ignites across the entire floor in radiant gold-and-white light, sending columns of pure magical luminescence crashing to the vaulted ceiling. PURE-AURA WRAP — WARLOCK: Violet-and-black arcane currents explode outward from the warlock's body, wrapping her entirely in a churning corona of class-coded energy. CASCADING GLYPHS — RUNIC-SCRIBE: An avalanche of floating script cascades through every corner of the hall — glowing arcane symbols spinning, overlapping, streaming in luminous rivers around the Runic-Scribe. ARCANE VORTEX — SORCERER: A wild multi-color magical vortex detonates at the sorcerer's core, expanding to consume the entire room in spinning arcs of chaotic prismatic energy. SUMMONING-CIRCLE FIRE — NECROMANCER: A colossal summoning-pattern blazes across the chamber floor in pale spectral-blue soul-light, six towering light-pillars rising from each rune-point to the vaulted ceiling. PURE-LIGHT CASCADE — CLERIC: Overlapping vertical columns of radiant golden-white magical-light crash through the hall from ceiling to floor, converging on the cleric at the center. The runic-scribe unleashes a cascading glyph-storm — thousands of floating arcane-script fragments spiral outward in expanding rings, filling every cubic inch of the hall with drifting, glowing symbols. The druid's emerald-and-jade ethereal aura detonates in a massive pure-aura bloom — vast sheets of green mystical luminescence rolling outward from his body to wash every surface in shifting jade light. His robes churn in the aura-current, hair streaming horizontally, while the room fills with suspended jade magical motes swirling in slow vortex-patterns around the brilliant emerald silhouette of his form.

A sorceress at the hall's center releases cascading chaos — multi-color glyphs erupt in overlapping tidal waves flowing ceiling to floor, her body wrapped in wild arcs of gold, violet, and scarlet arcane light. The air itself bends and refracts around her in a shimmer-field, every column reflecting distorted prismatic magic while her robes and hair whip in the colliding magical currents.

The mage's arcane vortex opens — a vast blue-and-silver spinning column of pure magical energy filling the hall from floor to ceiling, rune-fragments orbiting in tight rings as the vortex expands. She stands at the eye, utterly still, while the vortex-wind shreds her robe-edges and lifts her hair in a silver-lit crown, the surrounding floor cracked open with cascading blue rune-light pouring upward.

Archmage — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM: A ten-meter geometric spell-circle ignites across the entire flagstone floor in concentric rings of silver-white fire, each runic segment blazing to life in sequence until a forest of blinding light-pillars erupts from every rune-point, driving straight to the vaulted ceiling. Sorceress — CHAOS-RIBBONS PRISMATIC SWIRL: Wild loops of crimson, violet, and molten-gold chaos-ribbon erupt outward from the sorceress in every direction, filling the entire hall with unpredictable arcing bands of multi-color magic that slam into walls and ricochet back through the air in overlapping layers. Warlock — PORTAL RIFT BLOOM: A colossal planar rift tears open across the full width of the hall, its ragged oval mouth spanning floor to ceiling and pouring sickly green-black otherworldly light in thick columns that sweep across every surface like searchlights. The warlock stands directly before the rift's threshold, his silhouette barely legible inside the overwhelming bloom, one arm thrust forward with fingers splayed wide as if pressing against the boundary between worlds, his heavy coat rippling violently backward. The hall's stone shudders visibly, hairline fractures spiderwebbing outward across the floor from his boots, and the torches in their sconces have been completely extinguished, replaced by the rift's cold fel-glow painting every carved surface in sickly jade.

Necromancer — SUMMONING CIRCLE SOUL-LIGHT: A vast ritual circle blazes open across the floor in bone-white and deep violet, its nested rings packed with dense funerary script, and from each of the twelve outer rune-points a column of pale soul-light roars upward to pierce the ceiling like spectral spears. The necromancer kneels at the circle's center with both hands pressed flat to the stone, his robes pooling outward and lifting at the edges in the rush of escaping spiritual energy, his face illuminated from below by the sickly white light pouring up through the cracks between his fingers. The hall fills with drifting translucent shapes half-formed from the soul-light, the columns and archways webbed with pale violet luminescence, and the temperature of the air drops so sharply that the necromancer's exhaled breath trails as frost-mist through the ghostly glow.

Storm-Caller — ELEMENTAL LIGHTNING STORM: Dozens of lightning forks detonate simultaneously across the full height and width of the hall, floor-to-ceiling bolts cracking between the stone columns in a continuous overlapping storm that fills the entire chamber with blinding white-blue electrical fire. The storm-caller stands at the hall's center with both arms raised overhead, her leather-bound staff a lightning rod above her fists, her wild hair standing fully vertical and haloed by a corona of branching discharge, her face turned upward and washed completely white by the strobing brilliance. Every metal fixture in the hall pulls arcs of electricity to itself, the air has become a thick ozone haze, and the stone floor's veins of iron ore glow faintly red with absorbed heat running outward in branching patterns from the storm-caller's feet.

Runic-Scribe — RUNIC STORM GLYPH CASCADE: Hundreds upon hundreds of blazing amber-and-white rune-scripts burst simultaneously from every surface — floor, walls, ceiling — converging on the chamber's center in a cascading storm of floating calligraphic fire that fills the hall with dense layered streams of arcane text spiraling inward. The runic-scribe stands at the storm's contracting eye, both hands moving in rapid fluid gestures as though conducting the cascade, his ink-stained robes whipping furiously, the floating glyphs grazing past his body close enough to leave luminous tracks across his sleeves. The hall's ancient carved inscriptions — dormant for centuries — blaze back to brilliant life in response, every column's decorative script burning amber, and the air itself seems to thicken with the weight of accumulated meaning until visibility beyond ten feet dissolves into a wall of burning letters.

Cleric — LIGHT CASCADE CONVERGENCE: Overlapping columns of blinding holy-gold light crash simultaneously downward from the vaulted ceiling and surge upward from the floor, meeting at the hall's midpoint in an explosive convergence that saturates every cubic meter of air with layered white-gold radiance so thick it becomes almost liquid. The cleric stands at the convergence point with arms outstretched in a cruciform spread, head thrown back, her ceremonial vestments billowing upward in the light-wind, her entire form haloed by a secondary corona of pure white fire where the ascending and descending beams intersect at her chest. The ceiling's stone reliefs are outlined in scorching gold, every shadow in the hall has been annihilated, and motes of solidified holy-light drift slowly down through the convergence like luminous ash from a sacred fire.

Shadow-Mage — ARCANE VORTEX VOID SPIN: A churning vortex of absolute darkness and deep indigo magical energy fills the entire upper two-thirds of the hall, spinning with enough force that loose stones and splinters of mortar are being torn from the walls and absorbed into its rotating mass, the eye of the void sitting directly above the caster's raised fist. The shadow-mage stands below the vortex's pull with one arm extended straight up into its base, her black robes shredding upward into the spin, her hair a violent column drawn toward the eye, her face barely visible in the near-total darkness save for two points of cold violet light behind her eyes. The hall's torches were consumed minutes ago and the only light comes from the vortex's inner walls — flickering negative-light that shows shadows where there should be brightness, outlines every column in inverse white, and turns the ceiling into a bruised wound of spinning indigo.

Hedgewitch — CHAOS-RIBBONS NATURE-WILD SURGE: Thick ropes of living forest-magic in deep green and burning amber swarm out from the hedgewitch in every direction, wrapping columns, snaking across the ceiling, and looping back through the air in dense chaotic braids that fill the entire hall with twisting vegetative magical-ribbons studded with bursting bud-light and scattering luminous seeds. She stands at their origin point with her feet planted wide and her arms thrown open, her layered patchwork robes pressed flat against her body by the outward pressure of the surge, her face upturned and lit gold-green as a dozen of the ribbons spiral upward directly past her ears. The hall's stone floor splits in thin hairline cracks along its mortar lines and from each crack a thread of actual moss and root erupts, glowing faintly green, the walls sweating with the sudden warmth of deep-earth magic pressing outward from within the stone itself.

Battle-Mage — ELEMENTAL FLAME CONE ERUPTION: A colossal cone of churning fire blasts outward from the battle-mage's forward thrust, filling the entire far half of the hall with a roaring column of orange-white flame wide enough to swallow four men abreast, its superheated wake slamming back through the room in a wave of amber radiance and rolling black smoke. He stands planted at its origin with his armored feet braced wide, his free arm thrown back for counterbalance, his tabard burning away at the trailing edges in the backdraft, the visor of his battle-helm glowing cherry-red from the reflected heat. The far wall of the hall is a furnace door, every stone block in it radiating orange heat-glow, the ceiling above the cone's path scorched black and dripping burning lime-mortar, and the hall's air has become a dense convection of smoke, ember, and shimmering heat-distortion.

Chronomancer — ARCANE VORTEX TIME-SHEAR: A spiral vortex of fractured time-light tears open across the full height of the chamber, its spinning interior showing flickering glimpses of the same hall at different moments — crumbled, pristine, aflame, flooded — all strobing simultaneously in a sickening overlap of overlaid realities that fills sixty percent of the visible air with cascading temporal imagery. The chronomancer stands at the vortex's eye with one arm raised and the other pressed to her temple, her robes cycling through rapid color-shift as ambient time distorts around her body, the edges of her form slightly doubled as local causality fractures. The hall's columns appear and disappear in rhythmic pulses, their carved surfaces alternating between states of ruin and wholeness, the floor beneath her feet split between two versions of itself, and the air smells simultaneously of ancient dust and of fresh-cut stone.

Druid — SUMMONING CIRCLE EARTHBOUND: A massive earthen-green summoning pattern thirty feet across blazes open across the hall's floor in layered rings of root-script and stone-glyph, and from its eight outer anchor points vast columns of deep earth-light surge upward — not fire but something older, a slow green-gold luminescence like sunlight through deep canopy pressing up through solid stone. The druid kneels at the pattern's core in a low crouch, both palms flat to the stone, his antler-crowned staff levitating upright before him, his rough-spun robes pulled outward flat like a shadow by the radial magical wind, face pressed close to the blazing floor geometry. The hall's stone walls perspire with rising moisture, the carved fauna in their decorative friezes appear to stir and breathe in the green-gold light, and a low subsonic vibration moves through the floor and up every column so powerfully that dust falls in continuous curtains from the ceiling's highest vaults.

Blood-Mage — AURA PULSE WRAP CRIMSON FLOOD: A devastating pulse of deep crimson blood-magic erupts outward from the blood-mage's chest in a single expanding sphere that fills the hall wall-to-wall in one overwhelming wash of red-black light, every surface instantly saturated in the color of arterial fire, the aura so dense that the far end of the chamber has become a scarlet fog. Fey-Witch — CHAOS-RIBBONS PRISMATIC FAE STORM: Cascading ribbons of every visible color and several that have no name explode outward from the fey-witch in a wild careening storm, each ribbon trailing sparks of silver starlight and leaving afterimage traces burned into the air, the entire hall wrapped in an overlapping lattice of prismatic fae-fire that shifts and reweaves itself in real time. Fey-Witch — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM FAE GEOMETRY: A spell-circle of alien fae-geometry ignites across the floor in silver-rose and deep teal, its segments divided not into clean angles but into curves within curves, organic spirals that breathe and shift as they blaze to full brightness, with pale silver light-pillars rising not in straight columns but in slow gentle spirals from every rune-bloom point. Mage — ARCANE VORTEX DEEP-SPIN: A titanic arcane vortex opens across the full width of the hall's upper volume, its churning blue-white chaos filling every cubic meter of air above head height with roaring compressed magical energy, the eye of the storm directly above the mage's upheld focus-shard, pulling the hall's atmosphere into a visible counter-rotating inner cone. The mage stands directly beneath the vortex's mouth with his focus raised in both hands above his head, his robes stripped nearly horizontal by the inward gale, his body a black silhouette against the blue-white chaos overhead, boots sliding slowly inward on the stone floor against the pull. The hall's columns groan in their foundations under the vortex's lateral pressure, and the carved stone ceiling at the eye-point above the mage shows stress fractures spreading in slow arcs, each crack immediately lit from above by the blue-white chaos-light pressing down through them like searchlights through shattered ice.

Runic-Scribe — ARTIFACT ORBITAL SCROLL CROWN: Every scroll tube, rune-tablet, and etched shard in the hall tears free and joins a vast orbital crown that builds itself in concentric rings around the runic-scribe at chest-height and above, a dense rotating constellation of fifty or more artifacts spinning at different speeds and angles, each trailing streams of released inscription text that fills the air between them with a luminous web of golden and red script. The hall around the orbital is entirely repainted in the shifting warm gold and deep red of the released inscription-light, the ceiling a mosaic of overlapping script-shadows that rotate with the constellation below, and the stone floor directly beneath the scribe shows a blazing copy of the orbital's pattern slowly etching itself into the flags.

Blood-Mage — SUMMONING CIRCLE SANGUINE RITUAL: A vast sanguine summoning circle blazes open in deep red and black across the full floor of the hall, its rings packed with blood-script that pulses with each beat of the caster's heart, and from its twelve anchor runes towers of dark-red light surge upward to the ceiling, each column thick as a stone pillar and pulsing with internal luminance like blood through a vein. The blood-mage stands at the circle's center with both arms raised and fists clenched, blood-light rising visibly through the veins of her forearms in branching luminous traces, her dark ceremonial robes pressed outward by the surge of rising column-light, her face illuminated entirely in deep arterial red from below. The hall's walls sweat with the heat of the ritual's intensity, the mortar between the stone blocks tracing the hall's hidden drainage channels in thin lines of oozing warmth, and the air is so thick with blood-magic resonance that the torches in their sconces burn a deep sustained crimson rather than orange, their smoke rising in slow spiraling ribbons that avoid the summoning columns entirely.

Archmage — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM: A ten-meter spell-circle ignites across the entire hall floor in cascading segments of cobalt and silver geometry, each rune-point erupting into a floor-to-ceiling light-pillar that fills the upper half of the chamber with a blazing lattice of intersecting beams. The archmage stands at the circle's center with both arms raised overhead, robes shredding at their hems in the upward magical wind, silver hair suspended vertically, face bathed in cold blue-white radiance from every direction at once. Every carved column in the hall brands itself with reflected geometric light, the vaulted ceiling trembling as the pillars strike it and bloom outward across the stonework in branching luminous cracks.

Sorceress — CHAOS-RIBBONS CASCADE: Wild ribbons of crimson, violet, and molten gold chaos-energy loop unpredictably through the entire hall, coiling from floor to ceiling in thick streaming bands that cross and knot through every corner of the room. The sorceress is barely visible at their churning center, one arm thrust outward and one curled inward against her chest, her layered scarlet robes caught in the ribbons' turbulent current and stretched in three directions simultaneously, dark hair fanning in a wild halo. Every wall reflects the shifting prismatic bands in overlapping pools of color that crawl and ripple across the stone like living stained glass.

Warlock — PORTAL BLOOM: A vast rift tears open behind the warlock and blooms outward to fill seventy percent of the visible hall, its edges ragged with shredding violet-black energy and its interior flooding the chamber with the cold, sourceless light of a plane that has no sun. The warlock stands as a near-silhouette before it, arms spread wide with fingers splayed, cloak ripped horizontal by the rift's inward pull, the outline of his body barely readable against the overwhelming luminous depth. The hall's floor-stones lift fractionally at the seams and every torch bracket tears from the wall, dragged sideways toward the rift's howling threshold.

Necromancer — SUMMONING-CIRCLE IGNITION: A colossal ritual circle blazes to life across the entire floor, its concentric rings packed with death-script in sickly green-white fire, bone-light columns surging from each outer rune-point and converging overhead in a cathedral of pale soul-light that overwhelms the hall's own ceiling. The necromancer kneels at the circle's innermost ring with both palms pressed to the stone, tattered black robes pooling outward, skull-pale face illuminated from directly beneath by the igniting glyphs, eye sockets hollowed by the harsh upwelling light. The hall's air thickens with drifting grey motes like ash that has forgotten gravity, and every surface warms from cold grey stone to a sickened bone-ivory hue.

Storm-Caller — LIGHTNING VORTEX: Dozens of lightning forks crack simultaneously floor-to-ceiling through the entire chamber, branching and rebranching until the air itself is a dense lattice of white-blue electrical discharge that leaves no dark space in the room. The storm-caller stands suspended six inches above the floor at the vortex's eye, arms locked wide and head thrown back, leather-and-iron storm-robes shredded at the shoulders by the constant arc, every metal rivet on the garment shedding its own tiny satellite spark. The hall's stone columns blacken and crack at their tops where the longest forks strike them repeatedly, and the ceiling rains a continuous fall of pulverized mortar through the electric haze.

Cleric — HOLY-LIGHT CASCADE: Overlapping columns of pure white-gold holy light crash downward from the vaulted ceiling and surge upward from the floor simultaneously, converging in the hall's middle air in a blinding lattice of divine luminescence that saturates every surface in the room from every angle at once. The cleric is at the convergence point with arms outstretched and head bowed, vestments billowing outward as if underwater, the light so total that her body registers only as a warm silhouette inside an overwhelming bright bloom. The hall's carved relief figures on every wall glow as if fire-lit from within, the mortar joints between stones running with rivulets of golden light that pool and spread across the floor like warm liquid.

Blood-Mage — AURA PULSE WRAP: A deep arterial-crimson aura erupts outward from the blood-mage in a single room-flooding pulse that paints every surface in the hall with saturated red magical light, the walls running with it like the stone itself has become translucent over something vast and warm. The blood-mage stands with arms drawn inward and fists clenched at sternum height, dark robes lifting in the aura's outward shockwave-wind, veins along both forearms illuminated from within by crawling red light, face set and pale against the overwhelming crimson saturation. Every iron fitting in the hall — hinges, torch-brackets, door-bolts — weeps small beads of rust-red condensation in the aura's oppressive warmth.

Runic-Scribe — GLYPH CASCADE: Hundreds of blazing amber glyphs erupt outward from the runic-scribe's open manuscript in an accelerating cascade, the script spiraling outward and upward to fill the entire hall in a dense blizzard of floating luminous symbols that overlap in mid-air at every height and angle. The scribe stands inside the cascade with both arms extended palms-up, the book suspended and spinning before his chest, ink-stained robes whipping in the magical symbol-wind, spectacles cracked and glowing amber from the light striking them directly. The hall's own carved inscriptions on column and lintel ignite in sympathy, their dormant runes lighting sequentially around the room in a racing amber chain-reaction.

Druid — ELEMENTAL ERUPTION: A massive eruption of living-root, compressed stone-wind, and raw earth-force detonates outward from the druid's planted feet, flooding the hall with a churning green-brown vortex of debris, pollen-light, and spinning bark-shards that obscures every wall behind a solid curtain of wild elemental force. The druid is rooted at the center, bare feet pressed to the buckling floor, arms thrust skyward with fingers spread wide and bark-like markings along both arms blazing brilliant emerald, travel-worn robes long since torn away by the force pouring through the chamber. The hall's stone floor cracks in radiating lines from the druid's feet, young roots forcing upward through the gaps and spreading across the stonework while moss detonates across every column in rapid blooming patches.

Chronomancer — ARCANE VORTEX: A churning vortex of fractured time-energy tears open at the hall's center, the spell manifesting as a spinning column of superimposed past-and-future images of the room itself overlaid in translucent layers — the same hall in ruin, in construction, in fire, in ice — all rotating around the vortex's still grey eye. The chronomancer stands suspended at the eye with one arm reaching into the spin, the other pressed flat to their side, robes unwinding into temporal ribbons at the edges and fraying into echo-images of the garments as they were, their face aged and young simultaneously in overlapping exposures. The real hall around the vortex vibrates between its states — columns flickering built and collapsed, the ceiling present and absent, the floor alternating stone and void in stuttering rhythm.

Fey-Witch — CHAOS-RIBBONS PRISM: Long, weightless ribbons of iridescent fey-light — ice-white, petal-pink, deep forest-violet — unspool from the fey-witch in every direction simultaneously and loop through the hall's entire volume in slow, hypnotic coils that brush the ceiling, wind around every column, and pool in luminous drifts across the floor. The fey-witch drifts three feet off the ground inside the ribbon-cloud, bare feet pointed downward, arms stretched wide with wrists trailing their own streams of new ribbon-light, silver hair fanning outward in a full halo and braids unwinding slowly in the magical current. Every glass vessel and crystal fitting in the hall fractures into intact pieces that float in place, each fragment catching and splitting the ribbon-colors into thousands of tiny prismatic shards of projected light that crawl slowly across every surface.

Battle-Mage — LIGHTNING STORM ERUPTION: A storm of raw battle-lightning detonates outward from the battle-mage's war-staff in a simultaneous discharge of thirty or more heavy forks that crack floor-to-ceiling through the length of the entire hall, the overlapping discharges so dense that the hall's air becomes a solid white-blue smear of connected electrical energy. The battle-mage is planted wide-stance at the storm's origin, war-staff driven into the cracking floor-stone, heavy armored robes blasted back flat against their body by the concussive discharge, scorched at the hem, face locked in concentration and washed white by the total electrical blaze. Every metal surface in the hall — armored display-stands, iron door-bands, chandelier chains — becomes a secondary conductor, shedding continuous smaller arcs between them in a web of sympathetic discharge that fills the upper chamber with a constant crackling haze.

Mage — SPELL-CIRCLE LATTICE: A complex geometric spell-circle twenty feet across ignites across the hall floor in rapid sequence, its outer ring blazing violet, inner rings burning cool white, the rune-points at each vertex shooting vertical pillars of conjured light to the vaulted ceiling where they spray outward like inverted fountains to drench the upper hall in cascading magical illumination. The mage stands inside the innermost ring with robes pressed flat against their body by the upward light-column surge, both arms raised to guide the ignition sequence, features fully dissolved into the overwhelming white-violet radiance pouring from every direction. The hall's ceiling, struck by all pillars at once, rings like a bell and sheds a continuous slow rain of fine stone-dust and drifting light-motes that descend through the blazing circle in glittering vertical streams.

Shadow-Mage — SHADOW-TENDRIL ERUPTION: Massive tendrils of living shadow erupt from the floor and walls of the entire hall simultaneously, thick as pillars, writhing and coiling through the full volume of the room until the air itself is a dark knot of churning shadow-mass shot through with deep purple void-light at every intersection. The shadow-mage stands inside the eruption with arms lifted and fingers hooked downward, black robes merging at the edges with the tendril-mass so the boundary between caster and spell is indistinct, face barely readable — only the pale line of the jaw and the violet glow of the eyes cut through the surrounding dark. Every torch in the hall is extinguished and then re-ignites as black fire, the flame-color inverted, casting a purple-shadow anti-light that makes the familiar stone geometry of the hall seem reversed and wrong.

Hedgewitch — RUNIC STORM GREEN: Hundreds of hedge-script runes in deep forest-green and pale bone-white erupt upward from the hedgewitch's carved-wood staff and spiral outward in an accelerating storm that fills the entire hall in a thick blizzard of spinning luminous symbols, the outermost runes colliding with the walls and dissolving in bright flashes. The hedgewitch is inside the rune-storm's churning column with both hands locked on the staff, layered green-grey robes tearing at the sleeves and hem as the magical wind shreds the fabric edges, tangled hair streaming fully vertical above her head. The hall's hearthstone cracks and from the crack a green warmth bleeds outward across the floor in spreading pools while every dried herb bundle hanging from the rafters ignites briefly into small green-flame torches before turning to drifting luminous ash.

Sorcerer — PORTAL RIFT TORN: The sorcerer tears a massive planar rift open across the full width of the far hall wall, the portal blooming from a hand-width crack to a cathedral-scale opening that floods the entire chamber with the amber-and-black light of the plane beyond, the rift's edges fraying into long crackling tendrils of torn dimensional fabric. The sorcerer stands with both hands gripping the rift's lower edge as if physically forcing it wider, robes thrashing in the pressure-differential wind that howls inward, body bent backward with the effort, every exposed surface of skin amber-lit from the overwhelming otherworldly luminescence. The hall floor beneath the rift bows downward fractionally at the seams, the stones groaning, while the ceiling above it develops a spreading network of fine fracture-lines that glow amber at their edges as the dimensional pressure transmits through the structure.

Archmage — ARTIFACT ORBITAL STORM: Every tome, scroll, orb, and arcane instrument in the hall tears free of its shelf and cabinet simultaneously and erupts upward into a blazing orbital constellation that fills the hall's full height, the objects spinning in tiered rings and shedding trails of blue-gold magical light as they rotate, the whole constellation a storm of swirling arcane matter forty feet across. The archmage stands beneath the constellation's spinning center with arms raised and outstretched, robes whipping in the orbital wind of the passing objects, face turned skyward and fully illuminated by the cascading reflected light from dozens of circling glowing surfaces. The hall's bookcases stand empty and splayed as if struck, pages that escaped their volumes papering every wall in a single layer of windblown white, each page glowing faintly at its edges from the residual magic bleeding from the orbital above.

Cleric — SUMMONING COLUMN: A summoning-circle of radiant white and deep brass ignites across the full floor of the hall, and from its six outer rune-points six massive columns of divine soul-light surge upward and converge overhead in a single overwhelming beam that drives straight into the vaulted ceiling and spreads across it in a total white blaze. The cleric kneels inside the innermost ring with head bowed and both palms flat on the stone, vestments lifting straight upward in the convergence-column's suction-wind, every embroidered symbol on the fabric blazing independently in sympathetic response. The hall's upper windows blow outward from the pressure of the ceiling-bloom and the light that pours from them re-enters the space as reflected beams from the exterior walls, adding secondary light-columns that intersect the primary summoning at irregular angles.

Warlock — VOID AURA SATURATION: A total void-purple aura detonates outward from the warlock in a single overwhelming pulse that floods the hall's entire volume simultaneously, every surface — floor, ceiling, column, arch — drenched in deep fel-violet luminescence that has the quality of consuming rather than reflecting the light it spreads. The warlock stands at the pulse-origin with arms flung wide and head snapped back, long coat pressed flat against their body by the pulse's outward force before snapping back in the aura-wind's reversal, the very air around them compressed and shimmering with the aura's local density. The hall's carved grotesques along the cornices awaken in the fel-light, eyes opening as illuminated amber points of sympathetic void-energy, and the mortar between every stone runs with slow purple condensation that pools and spreads across the floor.

Necromancer — GHOST-SCRIPT VORTEX: A churning vortex of cold bone-white death-script spirals up from the ritual circle the necromancer has been working, the accumulated symbols forming a column of spinning arcane text that extends floor-to-ceiling and fills the hall's width with cascading streams of glowing glyphs, each one a name or a binding or a door. The necromancer stands inside the vortex column with arms crossed over the chest and chin lowered, threadbare black robes torn fully vertical by the upward spiral-wind, gaunt features lit starkly from below by the floor-circle and from the sides by the passing script, the light cold and without warmth. The hall's temperature drops to the point where every surface develops a skim of grey frost in seconds, and the condensation from the stone breathes outward in slow visible clouds that are immediately caught by the vortex and drawn into its rising spin.

Storm-Caller — RUNIC TEMPEST: Storm-runes in electric blue and ice-white erupt from the storm-caller's raised hands in a tempest of hundreds of spinning symbols that accelerate outward and upward to fill the hall's full volume with a dense blizzard of blazing arcane script riding a physical gale-force wind that the spell has conjured inside the enclosed space. The storm-caller is at the tempest's origin with both arms thrust skyward, boots locked against the floor-gale, storm-cloak ripped fully horizontal and shredding at its edges into trailing ribbons of torn fabric, face obscured behind a horizontal sheet of streaming silver hair. Every loose object in the hall is captured by the internal tempest and begins orbiting the room at increasing speed — papers, candlesticks, fallen masonry chips — each accumulating a corona of storm-rune light as it cycles through the script-blizzard.

Fey-Witch — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOSSOM: A fey spell-circle erupts across the hall floor in cascading rings of rose-gold and pale-green light, the geometric segments blooming in the pattern of an unfolding flower with each petal-segment igniting a tall thin pillar of iridescent fey-light that rises to the ceiling and refracts into prismatic fans across the vaulting. The fey-witch drifts upward inside the blooming circle as it ignites, bare feet lifting from the floor, arms curling outward at shoulder height, silver-white robes unwinding at the hem into cascading threads that float independently in the circle's upward energy-current. The hall's stone surfaces warm perceptibly and run with a fine film of petal-like luminous shapes that drift upward and dissolve near the ceiling, and from every hairline crack in the flagstone floor small clusters of glowing moss-flowers erupt into momentary bloom.

Blood-Mage — RITUAL CIRCLE CRIMSON: A vast ritual circle blazes to life across the hall floor in deep crimson and near-black sigil-light, the concentric rings dense with blood-script that ignites in sequence from the outer edge inward, each ring brighter than the last until the innermost ring blazes white-red, columns of arterial light surging from four cardinal rune-points to the ceiling where they bloom into expanding discs of blood-light. The blood-mage stands at the convergence of the four columns with hands pressed together at sternum height and then being drawn slowly apart, robes heavy and wet-dark at the hem from the ritual's cost, face lit sharply from four directions at once and rendered in harsh red-and-shadow chiaroscuro. The hall's walls weep thin lines of red condensation that trace the carved channels in the stonework, pooling in the mortar joints, and the air carries the iron-warm thickness of a closed space where the working has been long in preparation.

Chronomancer — PRISMATIC TIME SWIRL: Multi-color time-ribbons in overlapping gold, pale blue, and deep amber unspool from the chronomancer's suspended hourglass artifact in a wild prismatic swirl that fills the hall from floor to ceiling with looping, intersecting arcs of temporal energy, each ribbon carrying flickering images of the same space at different moments. The chronomancer floats inside the swirl with the hourglass artifact held at arm's length overhead, formal robes spiraling outward in overlapping temporal ghost-images of the same garment at different points in its existence, face simultaneously aged and young as the time-ribbons pass across it. Every wall in the hall shows competing versions of its own surface — fresh-carved, ancient and worn, rubble-collapsed, newly built — the competing pasts and futures cycling in slow overlapping waves that make the chamber's boundaries feel unreliable and breathing.

Mage — ELEMENTAL FROST ERUPTION: A massive eruption of raw frost-force detonates from the mage's planted stance, filling the hall with a floor-to-ceiling blizzard of ice-crystal formations that bloom from nothing in mid-air across the entire volume — jagged frost-columns rising from the floor, inverted ice-spires descending from the ceiling, the whole interior becoming a dense frozen forest of conjured ice shot through with cold blue light. The mage stands at the eruption's origin point with both arms thrust outward to the sides, blue-grey robes plastered against their body by the cold blast's initial wave, frost accreting visibly along the fabric's edges and the outstretched arms in advancing white crystal growth, breath crystallizing in continuous plumes. The hall's stone walls vanish behind thick accumulated frost within seconds, every carved surface buried in blue-white ice that glows from within, the vaulted ceiling ringing in sharp cracks as the thermal shock of the eruption propagates through the ancient stonework.

Archmage — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM: A ten-meter geometric spell-circle ignites across the entire hall floor in concentric rings of white-blue fire, each rune-segment blazing to life in rippling sequence outward from the archmage's planted feet, light-pillars erupting from every rune-point and slamming floor-to-ceiling in columns of pure arcane radiance. The archmage stands locked at the circle's heart, robes shredding at their hem in the upward magical current, both arms thrust wide and head thrown back, his entire silhouette strobing inside the overlapping pillar-light. Every vaulted rib of the ceiling absorbs and rebroadcasts the white-blue glow until the upper hall appears submerged in luminous water.

Sorceress — CHAOS-RIBBONS PRISMATIC SWIRL: Wild ribbons of crimson, violet, and gold chaos-magic unspool from the sorceress's body in every direction, looping in unpredictable arcs that fill the chamber from floor-level to the rafters, overlapping and splitting and rejoining in loops wider than the hall's pillars. Her form stands at the swirl's thrashing origin, spine arched backward, hair a vertical column of upswept strands suspended in the ribbon-wind, her gown's fabric pulling apart into fraying wisps at the sleeves and collar. Every wall reflects a fractured mosaic of competing colors — crimson on the left stone face, gold sheeting the right, violet pooling in every carved recess.

Necromancer — SUMMONING-CIRCLE IGNITION: A vast ritual circle of necrotic green-black flame blazes across the flagstone floor, its outer ring wide enough to touch both colonnades, bone-white soul-light columns punching upward from each of its twelve anchor-points and converging into a sickly halo near the ceiling's crown. The necromancer crouches at the pattern's core, one palm pressed to the stone and one raised aloft, robes billowing outward like a dark tide, his hollowed face washed in the cold green luminescence from below. The hall's pillars run with rivulets of reflected soul-light while a low harmonic resonance causes dust to rain continuously from the vaulted mortar joints above.

Storm-Caller — ELEMENTAL ERUPTION LIGHTNING STORM: Dozens of forking lightning arcs detonate simultaneously across the entire chamber, each bolt spanning floor-to-ceiling and crackling between the stone columns in branching white-gold chains that leave the air smelling of scorched rock, the collective discharge filling every cubic meter of the hall with blinding staccato light. The storm-caller stands legs wide at the eruption's axis, both fists clenched overhead, leather storm-coat shredded at the shoulders by the discharge, every strand of hair standing rigid and radiant, body lit from six directions at once by competing arc-paths. Scorch-black fracture-lines spider outward across the floor tiles in every direction from the caster's boots, and the iron chandelier overhead glows molten-orange from conducted heat.

Warlock — PORTAL RIFT BLOOM: A tear in planar space blooms open to fill seventy percent of the chamber's far wall, its ragged oval border writhing with eldritch violet flame while through its shuddering aperture an alien sky of bruised purple clouds and distant dying stars pours cold, lightless radiance into the hall. The warlock stands backlit before it, arms outstretched with fingers splayed, his silhouette barely readable inside the overwhelming violet bloom, his coat and hair streaming forward as if the rift inhales the room's air. The stone floor between the warlock and the rift has fractured into a radial pattern of cracks, each crack filled with seeping violet light, while the ceiling above pulses in slow waves of cold luminescence.

Cleric — LIGHT CASCADE CONVERGENCE: Columns of holy golden-white light crash downward from every bay of the vaulted ceiling simultaneously while answering columns of the same searing radiance surge upward from the floor's carved channel-lines, the opposing cascades meeting at mid-chamber height in overlapping bursts of pure incandescence that saturate every surface. The cleric stands inside the convergence zone, arms crossed over her chest and then flung wide at the spell's peak, her vestments billowing in every direction at once, her upturned face indistinguishable from the light itself. Every column capital in the hall has become a secondary source of reflected luminescence, and the hall's deep window-recesses brim with pooled golden light as if the stone itself has been made temporarily molten.

Runic-Scribe — RUNIC STORM GLYPH CASCADE: Hundreds of blazing amber script-characters erupt outward from the runic-scribe's opened tome in an explosive cascade, spiraling upward and outward until the entire chamber is thick with orbiting glyphs — some the size of a hand, some as tall as a man — rotating in nested shells of magical text that fill the air from floor to ceiling. The scribe stands at the cascade's origin, long coat snapping in the glyph-wind, spectacles lost somewhere in the torrent, both hands raised with fingers spread as if conducting the swirling characters into their orbits. The hall's carved wall-inscriptions glow in sympathetic resonance each time a live glyph sweeps past them, so that the entire chamber's stonework pulses in traveling waves of amber fire.

Blood-Mage — ARCANE VORTEX CRIMSON EYE: A churning vortex of dark crimson and deep scarlet arcane-energy consumes the upper two-thirds of the chamber, its rotation slow enough to see individual streamers of condensed blood-magic curling around each other as they feed the spiral's outstretched arms, which lash the walls and columns as they pass. The blood-mage stands at the vortex's absolute eye, arms extended horizontally, robes pulling upward and outward into the rotating mass until the fabric at the back billows into the vortex itself, her face tilted upward and bathed in churning red luminescence. The hall's pale stone walls have taken on the color of cooling embers, and thin rivulets of red condensate run down every vertical surface where the vortex's cold outer edge meets warm stone.

Druid — ELEMENTAL ERUPTION THORNSTORM: A storm of living vines, erupting bark-shards, and spiraling leaf-clouds explodes outward and upward from the druid's planted feet, filling the chamber with a roaring green-brown tempest of organic matter — branches as thick as arms spinning end-over-end near the ceiling, cascading leaf-streams corkscrewing around every column. The druid stands at the eruption's core, arms outstretched with fingers curled as if gripping invisible branches, antlered headdress torn free and spinning upward, root-woven robes shredding at every seam while green bioluminescent energy courses visibly through the exposed skin of the arms and neck. The hall's flagstone floor has buckled into a ring of upthrust stone plates around the druid, and moss and lichen bloom across every wall surface in fast-spreading luminescent patches.

Shadow-Mage — AURA PULSE WRAP UMBRAL: A single catastrophic pulse of void-black shadow-aura expands outward from the shadow-mage's body and floods the entire chamber in a single held breath, every surface swallowed in absolute darkness except where the aura's inner luminescence — a deep indigo that is somehow blacker than black — renders the room visible in negative, light and shadow inverted. The shadow-mage is suspended at the aura's origin, feet slightly above the floor, arms spread wide, robes hanging motionless in the shadowless negative-space, her face a pale mask surrounded by drifting dark-mote constellations that orbit her head in slow rings. The hall's window-openings have gone completely dark as if covered, and the only directional illumination comes from below — the floor's carved channels now running with cold indigo fire.

Chronomancer — RUNIC STORM TEMPORAL GLYPH CASCADE: Cascading streams of clock-faced glyphs and hourglass runes erupt in concentric expanding rings from the chronomancer's raised staff, filling the chamber with overlapping shells of silver-gold temporal script that hang frozen at various distances from the caster — each ring a snapshot of the eruption at a different moment, all visible simultaneously. The chronomancer stands at the frozen cascade's origin, silver robes billowing in a wind that blows in multiple contradictory directions at once, one hand raised with staff at full extension, the other hand held palm-out as if pushing against an invisible pressure, aged face lit from every angle by competing rings of silver radiance. The hall's hourglasses — decorative carved reliefs in the capitals — have begun trickling real sand upward, and the candle flames in every sconce burn motionless, suspended mid-flicker.

Battle-Mage — ELEMENTAL ERUPTION FIRESTORM CONE: A roaring cone of consolidated fire erupts from the battle-mage's forward-thrust gauntlet and expands to fill the entire far half of the chamber in a writhing mass of orange and white flame, the cone's edges wide enough to engulf both outer colonnades, the ceiling above the conflagration stained instant-black with rolling soot-clouds. The battle-mage is planted in a forward combat-lunge at the cone's base, armored elbow locked, the opposite arm flung back for balance, full plate-armor glowing dull red at the shoulder and breastplate from radiated heat, visor raised and face searing in the inferno-light. The hall's rear columns are wrapped in sheets of climbing fire, the mortar between their stone blocks cracking and smoking, and the entire upper chamber has become a rolling orange ceiling of fire-cloud and cinder-rain.

Fey-Witch — CHAOS-RIBBONS FAERIE SWIRL: Iridescent silver-green ribbons of fey-magic pour from the fey-witch's spinning body in every direction, corkscrewing through the chamber in wide unpredictable loops that leave glowing after-traces in the air — trails of luminescent color that linger and drift like disturbed smoke, layering over each other until the room is a dense web of fading and renewing light-paths. The fey-witch spins at the hall's center, one arm arched overhead, the other trailing, her layered insect-wing skirts fanning into horizontal arcs of shredding fabric-edge, flower-woven hair unraveling upward in the cascade's vortex-breath. Tiny luminescent motes — impossible to distinguish from awakened fireflies — fill the air in their thousands, drifting through every ribbon-arc, so that the hall's stone surfaces shimmer with continuous tiny highlights.

Sorcerer — ARTIFACT ORBITAL CONSTELLATION: Every tome, scroll, orb, and iron candlestick in the chamber has torn free of its resting place and erupted upward into a vast orbiting constellation that fills the hall's entire upper volume — heavy grimoires spinning in slow outer rings, crystalline orbs burning with inner fire at the mid-orbit, loose pages of script fluttering in fast inner rings around the sorcerer's raised form. The sorcerer stands at the constellation's gravitational center, feet lifted from the floor by the same force commanding the orbital, robes streaming upward and fragmenting into individual threads that join the inner ring's debris-field, his face upturned inside a halo of orbiting fire-lit spheres. The hall's shelves and lecterns stand empty, stripped clean, and the floor is covered in the concentric shadow-rings cast by the slowly rotating outer orbital layers.

Hedgewitch — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM VERDANT: A vast circular pattern of interlocking leaf-and-root geometry ignites across the entire hall floor in deep forest-green and gold-amber, its outermost ring extending to the base of both colonnades, each rune-node erupting into a column of warm green-gold light that climbs the full height of the chamber and fans against the ceiling vault in a bloom of botanical-light. The hedgewitch stands within the innermost ring of the pattern with arms raised overhead, wrists crossed, her patchwork robes billowing outward in the upward light-current, loose strands of herb-woven hair lifting free and streaming skyward. The hall's stone walls have grown a sudden skin of luminescent moss between each course of stone, and the carved foliate capitals on every column glow as if the stone were warm living wood.

Mage — PORTAL RIFT BLOOM ASTRAL: A circular rift in the fabric of the hall tears open at mid-chamber height, blooming outward until its diameter fills the room from colonnade to colonnade, its interior an infinite-depth swirl of silver-blue astral space — nebula-clouds in slow rotation, distant impossible geometries suggesting vast structures far beyond the rift's visible threshold. The mage stands suspended before the rift's face, both palms pressed flat against its membrane as if holding it open by force, blue-silver light pouring through the gaps between fingers and flooding outward to saturate the hall behind, robes and hair horizontal in the dimensional-pressure wind that pours from the opening. The hall's stone rear wall is no longer visible — replaced entirely by the rift's face — and the floor beneath the mage has been scoured clean of every particle of dust and grit by the astral wind.

Warlock — SUMMONING-CIRCLE FEL-LIGHT ERUPTION: A massive twelve-pointed ritual circle of fel-green fire blazes to full ignition across the hall floor with a detonation that throws green light to the ceiling in a single blinding flash, then sustains — each of the twelve anchor-points releasing a towering column of fel-light that burns with the concentrated intensity of a furnace-vent, the columns converging thirty feet above into a single coruscating mass of green-black energy. The warlock kneels at the circle's center with one hand flat on the cold stone and the other raised aloft, robes spreading outward across the blazing pattern, the fel-light washing all color from the face and replacing it with green-cast shadow-planes that shift as the columns flicker. The hall's iron fittings — hinges, chandelier-chains, torch-brackets — have all begun to glow faintly green from conducted fel-radiation, and every shadow in the room has been cast sharp and emerald-edged.

Sorceress — LIGHT CASCADE PRISMATIC: Overlapping columns of every-spectrum magical light crash simultaneously from ceiling-level and surge upward from the floor in counter-columns, meeting throughout the chamber's mid-volume in a continuous zone of overlapping polychromatic incandescence — red against gold, blue against white, violet against amber — every intersection producing a secondary bloom of mixed light that floods the surrounding stone. The sorceress stands inside the densest convergence, arms wide, head thrown back, her silver gown completely dissolved into the surrounding light so that only her silhouette's edge is visible as a slightly darker boundary inside the overwhelming bloom, loose hair a halo of individual backlit strands. The hall's stained-glass clerestory windows, dark from outside, have become secondary light-sources — the cascades striking them from within and throwing fractured spectrum-fans across the floor's carved stone.
