The hall's carved wall-inscriptions pulse in sympathy with the floating glyphs, the stone floor warming to a dull amber glow underfoot, and the air grows thick and heavy with the smell of hot copper and burning parchment.

Blood-Mage — ARCANE VORTEX CRIMSON: A churning vortex of dark crimson energy opens at the hall's center, spinning from the blood-mage's raised hand into a column of whirling chaos-force that reaches the full height of the chamber, its eye a perfect terrible void ringed in spiraling arterial-red light, debris and candles and loose pages all sucked into its orbit. The blood-mage stands at the vortex's absolute eye, body perfectly still against the howling rotation, their scarlet-stained robes pressed flat against them by the inward wind while their hair forms a perfect upward stream into the column above. The hall's tapestries are stripped from their hooks and consumed by the vortex's orbit, the stone columns groaning with a deep harmonic vibration, every mortar joint bleeding fine red dust outward into the spinning current.

Cleric — LIGHT CASCADE CONVERGING: Overlapping columns of pure holy-white light crash downward from the vaulted ceiling and surge upward simultaneously from the consecrated floor, converging from a dozen angles in a blinding overlapping lattice that fills every cubic inch of the chamber with white-gold luminescence, the light so dense it has physical texture. The cleric stands at the convergence-point with arms raised and face upturned, completely saturated in the overlapping beams, their vestments blazing white at the edges as though on the threshold of ignition, the holy symbol at their chest a second impossible sun. The hall's dark stone is entirely erased beneath the light-flood, every carved saint in the wall-niches illuminated in merciless detail, the mortar joints steaming faintly as centuries of cold are burned away by the cascade's heat.

Shadow-Mage — AURA PULSE WRAP DARKNESS: A vast wave of deep void-shadow aura explodes outward from the shadow-mage in a single overwhelming pulse, flooding the chamber from floor to ceiling in absolute lightless purple-black, every torch extinguished instantly, the only illumination the cold violet outline of the shadow-mage's own body at the aura's source and the faint ghost-light of shadow-runes drifting through the dark. The shadow-mage stands with arms pressed outward and head bowed, their form a violet-edged silhouette inside the consuming darkness, robes dissolving at the margins into flowing shadow-matter that merges seamlessly with the surrounding aura. The hall's geometry is swallowed entirely, only the column-shapes visible as slightly deeper darkness within darkness, and the stone floor transmits a cold that seeps upward through boot-leather and into bone.

Druid — ELEMENTAL ERUPTION VERDANT: A thunderous eruption of wild-magic growth explodes outward from the druid's planted feet, enormous root-thick vines surging upward along every wall simultaneously and a canopy of spectral forest-growth blooming across the full ceiling, the entire chamber transformed into a living green cathedral of impossible light-threaded foliage that fills the hall with layered emerald and deep shadow. The druid stands at the origin with legs braced and arms thrust skyward, face tipped up into the cascading vine-canopy, their bark-paneled robes shredding at the seams as the growth-force pushes outward through every fold of fabric. The hall's carved stone disappears beneath creeping luminous moss that spreads visibly up every surface, the floor cracking open in long seams from which pale root-light bleeds upward, and the air fills instantly with the dense scent of rain-soaked earth.

Chronomancer — RUNIC STORM TEMPORAL: Cascading streams of hourglass-gold arcane symbols pour outward in every direction from the chronomancer's raised staff, filling the hall in overlapping temporal-script that moves simultaneously forward and backward in its rotation, the floating glyphs stacking into dense curtains of shifting amber light that obscure the walls entirely. The chronomancer stands rigid at the staff's base, one arm braced against its haft and the other flung wide against the script-current, their robes layered with ghost-echoes of themselves caught a half-second out of phase, three translucent after-images of their own body overlapping in the temporal distortion. Every object in the hall exists in two or three simultaneous moments, candles both lit and extinguished at once, the stone columns streaked with the ghost-trails of their own geological ages, the air thick with the static-charge of compressed time.

Fey-Witch — CHAOS-RIBBONS GLAMOUR BLOOM: Iridescent ribbons of pure fey-magic — rose-gold, silver-teal, and deep blossom-violet — spiral outward from the fey-witch's spinning form in a wild blooming pattern, wrapping upward around every column and looping back through the chamber's center in overlapping arcs that fill the hall with layered luminous color from floor to vaulted arch. The fey-witch is caught at the ribbons' center in mid-movement, one arm arced overhead and the other swept low, her moth-wing layers of silk and petal shredded at every edge into drifting fragments that join the ribbon-currents. The hall's grey stone is entirely overwhelmed by reflected fey-light, every surface soft with overlapping color, the air thick with floating translucent petals and tiny drifting sparks of cold silver foxfire.

Battle-Mage — ELEMENTAL ERUPTION FROST: A catastrophic frost-blast erupts outward from the battle-mage's gauntleted fist, filling the entire hall in a roaring white-blue blizzard of crystalline ice-particles and raking cold-wind that forms towering hoarfrost formations on every wall, a frozen forest of white crystal spears growing upward to the ceiling in real time. The battle-mage stands wide-legged at the blast's origin, war-scarred armor rimed in ice, their outstretched arm locked rigid inside the outpouring, head turned aside from the force-blast, robes reduced to frozen stiff panels thrashing in the gale. The floor becomes a sheet of deep black ice that cracks and buckles under the rapid thermal collapse, every column encased in a growing sleeve of pale ice that climbs visibly from base to capital, the ceiling lost entirely behind a curtain of ice-crystal fog.

Archmage — ARTIFACT ORBITAL CONSTELLATION: Forty leather-bound tomes, a dozen glass orbs, and scrolls beyond counting erupt simultaneously from every shelf and surface in the archmage's sanctum, surging upward into a vast orbiting constellation that fills the hall's full volume — books open and pages streaming, orbs blazing with trapped light, the whole system revolving around the archmage's raised hand in nested shells of increasing speed. The archmage stands at the orbital's axis with one arm thrust straight overhead and the other pressed across their chest, their grey-council robes snapping in the rotational wind, face fully illuminated by the spinning constellation of light-filled orbs. The hall's shelves are stripped bare and the reading-tables upended, loose pages plastering themselves against the walls in layered drifts, the circular orbits scribing glowing track-lines of light into the air that persist after each object passes.

Sorcerer — PORTAL RIFT SHADOW: A rift to the deep void tears open floor-to-ceiling across the full width of the hall, its edges crackling with violent void-fire in deep indigo and absolute black, the space beyond the tear showing a starless dark shot through with slow-moving curtains of silver void-light, cold wind and the pressure of alien depth pouring into the chamber. The sorcerer kneels at the rift's threshold, one hand pressed flat against the tear's crackling edge-fire, their body half-silhouetted by the void-light behind them, robes pushed flat against their back by the outward pressure-differential. The hall's far wall is entirely replaced by the rift's interior, the floor in front of it crumbling at the edge in slow chunks that tumble into the void-dark below, and the chamber's air pressure drops palpably, candle-flames bending hard toward the tear.

Hedgewitch — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM WILDWOOD: A wild and organic spell-circle spreads across the chamber floor, its irregular geometry of root-curves and thorn-angles igniting in deep forest-green and pale bone-white, leaf-sigil light-pillars rising from each of its seventeen anchor-points in slow spiraling beams that twist like living vines toward the ceiling. The hedgewitch crouches low at the circle's heart with both hands pressed flat to the stone, her layered patchwork robes billowing outward around her in the radiant updraft, her knotted hair rising in sections as the pillar-beams warm the air above her. The hall's grey flagstone disappears under a spreading luminous moss that follows the circle's geometry exactly, the carved wall-faces of old stone saints taking on faint green-shadow expressions in the shifting pillar-light, and the air fills with a sound like wind through deep forest heard from far below ground.

Warlock — AURA PULSE WRAP FEL-VIOLET: A crushing wave of fel-violet aura detonates outward from the warlock's chest in an expanding sphere that floods the entire chamber simultaneously, every surface — floor, ceiling, column, arch — drenched in deep otherworldly violet that makes stone look like shadow and shadow look like void, fel-rune shapes visible within the aura's luminescence like slow-turning embers. The warlock stands at the pulse's origin with head thrown back and arms flung wide, their pact-marked coat shredding at the edges in the aura-pressure-wave, the fel-light illuminating the planes of their face from every angle simultaneously. The hall's iron torch-mounts glow a hellish orange from induced heat, the tapestries lose all visible color, drained to grey-shadow by the violet saturation, and the stone floor transmits a deep subsonic vibration that can be felt in the sternum.

Mage — RUNIC STORM SILVER-WHITE: An eruption of thousands of silver-white arcane script-fragments blasts outward from the mage's open hands in every direction at once, filling the hall's entire airspace with horizontal and vertical streams of floating magical characters, the density so great that they form writhing walls of light between every column, reducing the hall's interior to a series of luminous chambers within chambers. The mage stands at the storm's origin with arms flung outward and chin lifted, their travelling robes pressed flat against their front and shredded into streaming ribbons behind, the intense silver light sourced from every floating glyph illuminating them in hard flat white. The carved runes in the hall's foundation stones pulse in recognition of the overhead script, a deep harmonic resonance building in the walls, and the ceiling rains slow fat sparks of silver light that drift downward through the script-storm like snow.

Necromancer — RUNIC STORM DEATH-SCRIPT: A blizzard of bone-white death-script glyphs erupts from the necromancer's raised grimoire, streaming outward in dense layered currents that wrap the entire hall in overlapping walls of pale floating script, each glyph a binding-word or soul-clause that rotates slowly as it drifts, the cumulative light of ten thousand death-runes casting the chamber in cold bone-white. The necromancer stands within the scripture-storm with the grimoire held overhead in both hands, their dark robes plastered by the glyph-current against their body on one side and streaming away on the other, face illuminated in flat white from every direction simultaneously. The hall's stone memorial carvings seem to shift and rearrange in the moving glyph-light, the mortar joints bleeding a fine white powder into the air, and the temperature drops to the threshold of visible breath.

Chronomancer — PORTAL RIFT TEMPORAL: A massive temporal rift tears open at the hall's center, its aperture filled not with darkness but with layered translucent time — the same chamber visible through the rift in three different states simultaneously, ruined and intact and yet-to-be, all superimposed in flickering amber-edged transparency, the rift's perimeter crackling with golden clock-face fragments that orbit its edge. The chronomancer stands directly before the rift's center with both arms extended toward it, their robes existing in three simultaneous states — clean, worn, and tattered — flickering between versions at a pace that accelerates near their hands. The hall's real stones flicker in sympathy, the walls aging and de-aging in patches of grey-gold light, and every loose object casts three shadows at incompatible angles from three simultaneous light-sources bleeding through from the rift's layered interiors.

Druid — ARCANE VORTEX PRIMAL-STORM: A primal-force vortex of raw elemental wind and crackling green-amber lightning opens at the hall's center, its churning eye visible as a column of calm surrounded by a full-room-diameter wall of horizontal storm, leaves and stone-dust and torn fragments of bark pulled into its rotation in dense orbiting bands. The druid stands at the vortex-eye on the floor below it, arms spread wide, their bark-cloth robes flayed apart by the rotational wind into streaming vertical strips, their unbound hair a horizontal flag pointing inward toward the vortex-wall surrounding them. The hall's ancient mortar disintegrates in long strips pulled into the vortex's orbit, column capitals shedding carved leaves that are caught and added to the storm-debris bands, the ceiling cracking from the pressure-differential in long radial fractures that spread outward from the vortex's center.

Blood-Mage — SUMMONING-CIRCLE HEMOGLYPH: A vast blood-ritual summoning pattern blazes across the entire chamber floor in deep arterial crimson, its complex interlocking glyphs and sacrifice-marks burning with a wet organic light, soul-crimson columns of condensed blood-magic rising from each of the pattern's nine anchor-points to converge at the ceiling in a canopy of intersecting red beams. The blood-mage stands rigid at the pattern's heart with arms raised, their crimson-soaked robes wicking the pattern's light upward through every thread, face thrown back with jaw clenched against the force of the working, the blood-light giving their features a terrible depth. The floor's stone cracks along the pattern's lines and weeps dark liquid into the burning grooves, the air thick with iron-and-copper heat, every column in the hall reflecting the crimson canopy-beams in long vertical red stripes.

Storm-Caller — SPELL-CIRCLE LIGHTNING-RING: A colossal electrified spell-circle blazes into existence across the full floor of the hall, its concentric rings igniting in sequence in searing white-blue lightning rather than still light, every geometric segment arcing electricity between its boundary-lines, lightning-pillars blasting from each rune-point to the ceiling with continuous crackling roar. The storm-caller stands at the circle's center with arms raised and spread, partially lifted from the floor by the updraft-force, their layered storm-cloak shredded to horizontal strips by the charge-wind, every strand of their hair standing outward in a corona of static electricity. The hall's iron fixtures glow cherry-hot, the stone columns spalling chips driven outward by each lightning-pillar's shockwave, and the vaulted ceiling darkens with ozone-black scorch-marks that spread outward from each pillar's impact like charred sunbursts.

Fey-Witch — SUMMONING-CIRCLE GLAMOUR-RING: A fey summoning pattern of spiraling blossom-geometry ignites across the hall's floor in silver and pale rose-gold, its interlocking petal-arcs and thorn-circles blazing in sequence, glamour-light columns rising from each anchor-point in soft slow spirals of silver foxfire that drift and writhe toward the ceiling like ascending smoke made of light. The fey-witch stands at the pattern's heart with arms raised and hands open, her layered gown of silk and woven-shadow lifting in the glamour-updraft, face tilted skyward and suffused in silver-rose light, her long hair suspended upward in separate strands each catching a different color from the rising columns. The hall's grey stone softens entirely under the glamour-light, the carved wall-decorations seeming to breathe and shift, and the air fills with translucent drifting moths of condensed fey-light that spiral upward through the column-beams.

Shadow-Mage — ARTIFACT ORBITAL SHADOW-RING: Every dark-bound tome, rune-etched skull, and obsidian orb in the shadow-mage's study erupts upward simultaneously into a vast orbiting constellation that fills the hall's full height, the objects revolving in nested shells of increasing darkness, each shell leaving a trail of violet-black shadow-matter that thickens and writhes as the constellation accelerates. The shadow-mage stands at the orbital's axis beneath the lowest shell, one arm raised to anchor the working, their dark robes streaming upward into the orbital-current in long ribbons that blur into shadow-matter at their ends, face illuminated in cold violet from the artifact-trails above. The hall's torches are consumed one by one as the shadow-orbital's outer shells expand to reach the walls, the room's light replaced entirely by the cold violet glow of the orbiting artifacts, the floor below the mage the only warm stone remaining in a chamber otherwise given entirely to dark.

Archmage — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM: A ten-meter geometric spell-circle ignites across the entire stone floor in sequence, each rune-segment flaring white-silver as blazing light-pillars surge from every anchor-point to the vaulted ceiling thirty meters above. The archmage stands at the circle's absolute center, robes shredding at their trailing edges in the rising magical wind, both arms extended horizontal, face tilted skyward and washed entirely in silver-white convergence-light. Every column in the hall is branded with the reflected geometry, the ceiling's carved reliefs throwing sharp runic shadows across the upper dark.

Sorceress — CHAOS-RIBBONS SWIRL: Wild prismatic ribbons of chaos-energy uncoil from the sorceress's raised arms and loop unpredictably through the entire hall, floor to ceiling, wrapping every pillar and crashing back through the center in overlapping arcs of violet, crimson, and molten gold. Her body is half-dissolved inside the swirling mass, only her silhouette and the two pale points of her outstretched hands visible through the cascading color. Every wall surface reflects a fractured mosaic of the ribbons' shifting hues, the stone itself seeming to ripple as each new wave of color washes across it.

Necromancer — SUMMONING-CIRCLE IGNITION: A vast ritual pattern of interlocking death-sigils blazes across the floor in cold green-and-black fel-light, its outermost ring reaching every wall of the chamber simultaneously, and from each major node a column of soul-light erupts upward in a translucent pillar of swirling pale fire. The necromancer kneels at the pattern's heart, robes pooling around him and then lifting violently as the columns' updraft catches the fabric, skull-carved staff planted before him, face lit from below in sickly jade luminescence. The hall's air thickens with drifting bone-pale motes, and every iron wall-sconce is extinguished by the overwhelming fel-glow that now constitutes the chamber's only light.

Storm-Caller — ELEMENTAL LIGHTNING STORM: A full storm of arc-lightning detonates through the interior of the hall, dozens of forking bolts cracking simultaneously from floor to ceiling and pillar to pillar, the upper half of the entire chamber ablaze with branching white-blue electrical discharge that never fully resolves between strikes. The storm-caller stands in the storm's churning eye, boots leaving the ground by inches in the magnetic pull, leather-and-iron armor micro-crackling with surface charge, hair suspended rigidly upward in the electromagnetic field, jaw set against the roar. Every stone column between the walls bears a fresh brand where a bolt has kissed it, and the smell of ozone saturates the chamber so completely that visible vapor trails hang between the lightning paths.

Warlock — PORTAL RIFT BLOOM: A planar rift tears open across nearly the entire far wall of the chamber, blooming outward from the warlock's outstretched palm until its swirling void-light fills seventy percent of the visible space, the edges of the tear ragged and pulsing with deep violet and abyssal black. The warlock's body is a dark silhouette against the rift's overwhelming luminescence, robes billowing backward in the inter-planar wind pouring through the gap, one arm still extended at the rift's anchor-point, the other braced low for balance. The hall's floor cracks in a starburst pattern from the point directly beneath the warlock's feet, and the vaulted ceiling overhead drips cascading violet light that pools in every carved groove of the stonework.

Cleric — LIGHT CASCADE CONVERGENCE: Overlapping holy-light columns crash downward from every section of the vaulted ceiling simultaneously while answering columns burst upward from the floor's carved seams, the converging pillars filling the entire hall in a blinding lattice of white-gold radiance that leaves no shadow anywhere in the chamber. The cleric is pinned at the center of the convergence, arms spread wide, head thrown back, vestments torn outward by the column-winds, face entirely lost inside the light pouring down from above. The hall's stone floor glows warm amber beneath the converging columns, every individual floor-tile's grain visible through the translucent glow, and the altar at the room's far end has been bleached to pure white by reflected sacred light.

Shadow-Mage — ARCANE VORTEX: A churning column of shadow-energy three meters across and reaching the ceiling spins at the room's center, its outer edge drawing loose debris, torn parchment, and extinguished candles into a clockwise orbit around its absolute black core, the vortex walls dense with compressed dark-matter tendrils lashing outward before being re-consumed. The shadow-mage stands within the eye of the column, coat-tails whipping horizontal in the rotational wind, dark hair streaming in a perfect circle around the still point of their face, eyes open and pupilless-white from absorbed power. Every torch in the hall's sconces has been drawn physically sideways toward the vortex, their flames stretched into horizontal orange streamers, and the walls to either side of the room show deep circular scoring marks where the outermost tendrils have raked the stone.

Runic-Scribe — RUNIC STORM CASCADE: Hundreds of blazing copper-and-gold script-characters erupt upward from the scribe's open grimoire, expanding outward in cascading sheets that fill the hall from floor to gallery-level, each floating glyph spinning slowly on its own axis while maintaining its position in an enormous spherical constellation of living text. The runic-scribe stands at the constellation's origin point, robes lifting on the page-wind, one hand still pressed flat to the open book, the other raised with two fingers extended, face illuminated in warm copper light thrown by a thousand simultaneously glowing characters. The hall's shelved manuscripts along every wall flutter violently, and several have burst their bindings, loose pages joining the cascade as blank white shapes moving through the lattice of blazing script.

Druid — ELEMENTAL NATURE ERUPTION: An eruption of living vines, root-systems, and bioluminescent moss detonates outward from the druid's planted staff, covering every wall and pillar within seconds in thick green growth, while overhead a canopy of spectral branches expands to fill the entire ceiling with a living lattice through which deep forest-green light filters in shifting dappled patterns. The druid stands at the detonation point with both arms raised and head bowed, brown robes dissolving at their edges where the vines have already claimed the fabric as substrate, bare feet swallowed to the ankles by rapidly spreading moss. The hall's stone floor is invisible beneath a carpet of soft radiant undergrowth, and the air is suddenly thick with the smell of turned earth and the drifting silver spores of enormous conjured mushrooms cracking through the flagstones.

Blood-Mage — AURA PULSE WRAP: A deep arterial-crimson aura detonates outward from the blood-mage's body in a single overwhelming pulse, flooding the entire chamber floor-to-ceiling in rich blood-red luminescence that saturates every surface simultaneously and does not fade but simply holds, the entire room drenched as though submerged in red light. The blood-mage is suspended six inches above the floor at the pulse's origin point, arms pressed tight to their sides and back arched sharply, face upturned and painted entirely in the crimson bloom, robes drifting outward in all directions in the aura-wind. Every crack in the hall's stone work glows deeper red than the surrounding surface, as though the walls themselves have become circulatory, and the fine mist of suspended blood-droplets that constitutes the aura's medium catches the light in thousands of tiny ruby-lens reflections.

Chronomancer — ARCANE VORTEX: A vortex of fractured time-energy spins through the entire hall, visible as overlapping translucent echoes of the room itself — the same chamber at three different eras simultaneously occupying the same space, layered and flickering, the stone newer in one layer, collapsed in another, the overlaps generating cascading gold-and-silver shimmer wherever the time-layers intersect. The chronomancer floats at the vortex's still center, robes flickering between three versions of themselves in rapid succession, grey-streaked hair suspended upward in the temporal wind, one gloved hand raised with the hourglass-shaped focus held above their head at the anchor-point. The hall's present-time stonework fractures visibly in slow motion along hairline cracks that glow amber at their edges, and loose objects — candlesticks, tome-covers, spilled sand — orbit the chronomancer in perfect rings moving at three different speeds corresponding to the three temporal layers.

Fey-Witch — CHAOS-RIBBONS PRISMATIC SWIRL: Iridescent fey-ribbons of every color in the visible spectrum and several that appear not to belong to it spiral outward from the fey-witch's spinning form, looping the hall's entire interior in unpredictable arcs, passing through solid stone at the walls only to re-emerge from the floor, the geometry of the ribbons obeying no physical law, the chamber's interior laced with them from every angle. The fey-witch spins at the center with arms open wide, silver-white hair splayed in a full radial halo from the motion, diaphanous layered gown shredding at its lowest hem where the ribbons have caught it and pulled, laughter-lines around the eyes visible only because the face is illuminated in constantly shifting spectral light. Every iron fixture in the hall — candelabras, door-hinges, torch-brackets — is coated in a thin frost of fey-residue that refracts the ribbons' light into micro-rainbow patterns across adjacent stone.

Battle-Mage — ELEMENTAL FIRE ERUPTION: A cone of compressed fire expands from the battle-mage's gauntleted fist to fill the entire upper half of the hall in a sustained roaring inferno, the flame not a single wave but a continuously fed torrent, its edges churning with black smoke and white-hot ember-clusters that rain across every surface below. The battle-mage is braced wide-stance at the cone's origin, left arm locked back for counterbalance, right arm fully extended into the flame's mouth, battered plate-armor glowing orange across its leading surfaces, visor up and face exposed to the full heat, expression fixed in absolute concentration. The hall's tapestries on both side-walls have ignited from the radiant heat alone, burning in vertical orange columns that merge with the cone's smoke, and the vaulted ceiling above the inferno is charring black in a widening stain.

Mage — ARTIFACT ORBITAL CONSTELLATION: Every tome, scroll, crystal orb, and arcane instrument in the hall has been ripped from its shelf or plinth and launched into a massive orbiting constellation, hundreds of artifacts circling the mage at three nested ring-speeds, the outermost ring grazing the hall's walls, each object trailing its own thread of blue-white magical light that leaves ghost-traces in the air and builds a luminous spherical web filling the entire chamber. The mage hovers at the constellation's hub, cross-legged, robes perfectly still in an impossible calm eye while everything orbits around them, both palms open upward, face serene inside the overwhelming rush of circling objects. Every vacated shelf and plinth in the hall is lit from within by the glow-residue left by the objects' departure, and the air between every orbit-path is thick with drifting fragments of parchment and crystalline spell-dust shaken loose by the artifacts' acceleration.

Hedgewitch — RUNIC GLYPH STORM: Streams of bone-white and bark-brown runic script cascade upward from the hedgewitch's carved-wood staff, erupting in dense expanding sheets that fill the hall like a blizzard of living language, each character slowly rotating and humming with low harmonic resonance, the collective mass of floating script so dense in the room's upper half that the ceiling is no longer visible through it. The hedgewitch plants the staff with both hands and leans into it against the script-wind, layered skirts and tied herb-bundles at her belt all streaming upward in the rising current, face tipped back and illuminated in warm bone-white glyph-light from the cascade pouring over her. The hall's earthen-and-stone floor is covered in a shallow drifting layer of discarded script-characters that dissolve into fine ash on contact, and the bundles of dried herbs on the chamber's work-table have begun to glow faintly, each leaf etched in miniature with the same characters erupting overhead.

Sorcerer — PORTAL RIFT MULTI-BLOOM: Three simultaneous plane-tears bloom open across the hall at different heights — one spanning the full width of the floor, one tearing through the mid-air space between two columns, one cracking open across a section of vaulted ceiling — each filled with a different otherworldly light source, cobalt, deep amber, and pale white, all three flooding the chamber with overlapping planes of alien radiance. The sorcerer stands on the floor-level rift's glowing edge with toes at the tear, robes whipping backward in the outrushing inter-planar wind from all three rifts simultaneously, both arms outstretched to the side as though holding the tears open through arm-span alone, spine arched back against the pressure. Every stone surface in the hall is painted in tricolor where the three alien light-sources meet at overlapping angles, and the columns between the rifts cast triple-shadows in cobalt, amber, and white that spread in three different directions from each pillar's base.

Necromancer — RUNIC DEATH-GLYPH CASCADE: A storm of skull-faced glyphs and spiral death-script erupts from the necromancer's shattered phylactery, flooding the hall in cascading streams of cold grey-and-green characters that layer over every surface like a second skin of undead language, each glyph sinking slightly into stone before dissolving and being replaced by another from the cascade above. The necromancer is entirely enveloped, arms flung wide as the glyph-storm pours through and around them, robes dissolving into glyph-fragments at their edges, only the pale jaw and hollow eyes visible through the cascade, body more concept than physical form inside the overwhelming script. The hall's iron-banded doors are sealed under a thick crust of compacted death-glyphs, and the bones of whatever creatures were formerly displayed in the room's alcoves have begun to tremble, each one faintly etched by the passing script.

Sorceress — SUMMONING-CIRCLE SOUL-COLUMNS: An enormous twelve-pointed summoning-circle blazes across the full floor of the chamber in deep violet and cold blue, each of its twelve outer nodes igniting in sequence and launching a column of soul-light — translucent pale-violet fire-columns ten centimeters across and rising to the ceiling — that casts the hall in twelve competing vertical stripes of spectral luminescence. The sorceress stands at the circle's central sigil with one arm raised and the other pressing the circle's keystone rune into the floor, gown lifting and spreading in the updraft from the nearest soul-columns, dark hair pulled vertically upward in a perfect column above her head, face bathed in the competing violet-blue light. The hall's ceiling between the soul-column tops is a canopy of spreading violet luminescence where the columns' crowns have bloomed outward and begun to merge, and the shadows cast by every architectural feature in the room point inward toward the circle's center.

Warlock — AURA CORRUPTION FLOOD: A crawling void-black aura undershot with deep amethyst veining spreads outward from the warlock's body and floods the chamber from the floor upward, drowning the lower two-thirds of the hall in absolute shadow-light while the upper third burns with reflected purple from the aura's ceiling-contact above. The warlock walks slowly forward through the flooding aura with arms slightly raised from their sides and coat hanging motionless in the supernatural calm at the corruption's origin, face underlit by the amethyst veining closest to their feet, eyes fully dark from lid to lid. The hall's carved reliefs on every wall are slowly acquiring a black patina where the aura-shadow contacts the stone, the corruption reading as a stain that follows the aura's leading edge, and every glass vessel in the room has cracked along stress-lines as the pressure differential between the aura's interior and exterior peaks.

Cleric — LIGHT CASCADE CEILING-BURN: A single massive column of holy-white light crashes through the hall's domed ceiling from directly above and expands as it descends, filling the entire chamber by the time it reaches the floor in a cone of pure radiance so bright that the walls, the columns, and every architectural detail exist only as dark line-art outlines against the overwhelming white-gold. The cleric is at the column's ground-level center, on one knee with the holy-symbol held overhead in both hands, vestments billowing outward in the column-wind, face turned up and consumed by the light pouring down into it. The ceiling at the column's entry point is a jagged-edged hole of molten stone that drips luminous amber at its rim, and the entire floor of the hall glows warm gold at its surface with the column's ground-contact, the flagstone seams burning brightest of all.

Chronomancer — SPELL-CIRCLE TEMPORAL BLOOM: A double-stacked temporal spell-circle blazes across the hall, one vast geometric pattern on the floor and its inverted mirror blazing on the ceiling simultaneously, connected by a cylindrical column of amber time-light in the room's center, the floor-circle's rune-segments rotating clockwise and the ceiling-circle counter-clockwise at different speeds, the whole structure generating a low harmonic resonance audible as sub-bass vibration in the chest. The chronomancer stands inside the central cylinder at the midpoint between floor and ceiling, elevated three feet off the ground by the column's temporal pressure, robes rippling in two different directions simultaneously from temporal wind-shear between the two rotating circles, grey hair streaming upward on one side and downward on the other. Every clock-mechanism in the hall — sundials, hourglasses, water-clocks — has begun to run at radically different speeds, some blurring, some completely stopped, and the dust on every surface is suspended motionless in mid-air at exactly the height of the chronomancer's knee.

Druid — ELEMENTAL STORM ERUPTION: A contained tempest erupts inside the hall, a full interior storm with horizontal rain, ground-skimming fog, and branching cloud-to-floor lightning that fills every cubic meter of the chamber with weather, the rain moving in circular patterns driven by the storm's inner rotation, water sheeting across every stone surface and pouring off every architectural projection. The druid stands in the storm's calm eye with arms raised above their head and fingers spread wide, natural-fiber robes soaked flat to their body and hair pressed in wet ropes against their face, feet ankle-deep in the storm-water pooling across the floor, expression of absolute absorption. Every carved stone gargoyle and architectural figure in the hall is streaming water from its mouth and brow as though weeping from the storm's intensity, and in the chamber's far corners where the lightning paths converge, the stone walls have been struck black in spreading ferning burn-patterns that glow briefly red between each new discharge.

Blood-Mage — RUNIC BLOOD-SCRIPT STORM: Streams of crimson runic script written in suspended blood-medium erupt upward from the blood-mage's cut palm in cascading sheets, the characters huge and densely packed, filling the hall in every direction with a living text of deep scarlet on air, each character trailing a fine crimson filament back toward the mage's hand as though the script is still being written even as the earlier characters reach the far walls. The blood-mage stands with the cut hand raised high and the other arm thrown wide for balance, head back and spine curved, dark robes shredding at their lower hems as the script-streams tear through the fabric, face painted entirely red from the light thrown by the cascading characters surrounding them at every distance. The hall's white-marble floors are spattered in the pattern of the script's movement, each impact point a perfect character-sized mark, and the stone walls where the blood-script contacts them show a brief seeping-through effect as though the stone has momentarily become porous.

Fey-Witch — ARTIFACT ORBITAL FEYLIGHT: Every glass vessel, polished mirror-fragment, and crystal object in the hall is ripped airborne and launched into an orbital pattern around the fey-witch, hundreds of reflective and refractive pieces circling at high speed, each one catching her body's fey-light and throwing fractured spectrum patterns across every surface, the combined reflection-light of all pieces in orbit creating a second light-source of shifting rainbow intensity that equals or exceeds the hall's existing torchlight. The fey-witch spins slowly at the orbital center with arms open and chin lifted, silver gown spreading into the orbital paths, individual trailing threads of the fabric already caught and orbiting independently of the garment, her face visible only in the fractured split-second as each orbiting mirror-piece reflects it back. The hall's torches are all bent sideways in their brackets toward the orbital's centripetal pull, their flames parallel to the floor, and the stone walls directly opposite each mirror-piece's path are painted in moving spectrum-bars that sweep across the reliefs in continuous rotation.

Shadow-Mage — SUMMONING-CIRCLE VOID-COLUMNS: A vast eight-pointed summoning-circle blazes across the floor in absolute black light — a paradox of darkness so concentrated it reads as its own illumination — each outer node launching a column of void-fire upward, eight columns of pure darkness rising to the ceiling and spreading overhead in a black canopy that consumes the room's upper third. The shadow-mage stands at the circle's heart with hands pressed together and then slowly pulling apart, a ninth column of condensed void materializing between their palms and then merging upward with the canopy, eyes fully black from corner to corner, dark robes indistinguishable from the void-columns immediately flanking the figure. The hall's existing light sources — sconces, braziers, a great window — have not been extinguished but are instead visible as wan, defeated points within the void-canopy overhead, their output absorbed and converted, and the floor's stone beyond the circle's boundary is cold to visible effect, frost crystals forming in a ring exactly at the circle's outermost edge.

Archmage — SPELL-CIRCLE BLOOM: A ten-meter geometric spell-circle ignites across the entire hall floor, its concentric rings and interlocking triangles blazing gold-white in sequence, light-pillars erupting from every rune-point and driving upward to shatter against the vaulted ceiling. The archmage stands at the circle's exact center, robes torn outward by the rising magical wind, arms spread wide and face tilted skyward, his entire silhouette burning with reflected radiance from below. Every carved column in the hall is branded with the circle's reflected geometry, the stone floor between the runes glowing molten amber, and drifting geometric motes hang suspended in the thick, luminous air.

Sorceress — CHAOS-RIBBONS PRISMATIC SWIRL: Wild ribbons of violet, crimson, and electric gold chaos-energy loop and spiral outward from the sorceress in overlapping arcs, filling the entire chamber from floor to ceiling with unpredictable braided light that crashes against every wall and rebounds in new directions. Her body is wrapped at the ribbons' origin point, hair lifting in a wild crown, her robes shredding at every hem and cuff as the prismatic current tears through the fabric. Every wall reflects fractured multi-color light in overlapping pools, the ceiling's stone bosses dripping cascading prismatic haze, and the air is so thick with drifting spell-residue that the far end of the hall is barely visible.

Warlock — PORTAL RIFT BLOOM: A vast plane-tear rips open and blooms to fill seventy percent of the frame, its ragged oval edge crackling with fel-violet lightning while otherworldly amber and bone-white light pours through in churning columns. The warlock is a dark silhouette pressed against the rift's near edge, one arm extended into the light, robes whipping backward in the outflow wind, face half-consumed by the glare pouring from the other side. The hall's columns buckle with violet arc-lightning leaping between them, the floor splits in hairline fractures that glow ember-orange at the seams, and every shadow in the chamber has been replaced by deep violet fel-luminescence.

Necromancer — SUMMONING-CIRCLE IGNITION: A massive ritual summoning-circle blazes to life across the full breadth of the hall floor, its twelve concentric rings and hundreds of bone-white death-glyphs igniting in a wave from the outer edge inward, soul-light columns of cold blue-white surging from each cardinal rune-point toward the rafters. The necromancer kneels at the pattern's heart, both hands pressed to the stone, robes pooled outward in the cold wind the circle generates, skull-pale face illuminated from beneath by the death-light flooding upward through the floor. Every wall is washed in cold soul-blue, the ceiling's ribbed vaults drip with cascading ghost-light, and the air between the soul-columns shimmers with translucent rising forms.

Storm-Caller — ELEMENTAL LIGHTNING STORM: A full ceiling-to-floor lightning storm detonates inside the hall, dozens of forking white-blue bolts cracking simultaneously between the vaulted ceiling and the stone floor, the entire upper half of the frame a blinding branching lattice of electrical discharge. The storm-caller stands at the hall's center, both arms raised above her head, hair suspended fully upright and crackling with charge, her leather traveling-cloak shredded to ribbons that flutter and snap in the electromagnetic wind. Every iron sconce and metal fixture in the hall becomes a strike-point, arc-lightning leaping between the conduit-pillars in sustained loops, the floor scorched black in radiating patterns from the storm-caller's feet outward.

Runic-Scribe — RUNIC STORM GLYPH CASCADE: Hundreds of blazing amber and bone-white rune-glyphs erupt from the runic-scribe's outstretched scroll and expand outward in a cascading storm, the symbols growing as they spiral, filling the hall from floor to vault with a dense churning cloud of floating arcane script that rotates in vast slow wheels. The scribe is at the cascade's source-point, robes billowing in the outward rush, both hands spread wide with glowing ink running up to the elbows, face bright with the amber light of thousands of individual runes passing inches from his features. The columns are curtained in overlapping glyphs that brand their surfaces with residual light, the floor is a shifting carpet of projected rune-shadows, and the air carries the deep resonant hum of every glyph vibrating at its own frequency.

Battle-Mage — ARCANE VORTEX: A churning column of teal-and-white chaos-energy thirty meters in diameter spins into existence, consuming the entire hall, stone debris and broken furniture caught in its outer ring and spinning in a horizontal orbit while the vortex's inner eye burns clean and bright. The battle-mage stands in the absolute eye of the storm, sword raised vertically as the spell's anchor point, the blade incandescent with drawn energy, her armor plating rattling and her short-cropped hair horizontal in the spin-wind. The hall's outer walls shed fragments of mortar and carved ornament that feed into the vortex ring, every torch-bracket ripped free and orbiting, and the circular stone ceiling oculus above vibrates in its mounting from the sustained rotational force.

Cleric — LIGHT CASCADE CONVERGENCE: Overlapping columns of pure holy-white light crash downward from every ceiling vault and surge upward from every floor-joint simultaneously, the converging pillars filling the entire hall in a lattice of sacred radiance so dense the original stone architecture is barely legible. The cleric stands at the convergence's central axis, arms extended horizontally, head bowed as the light pours through and around her, her white vestments luminous from within rather than merely lit, her outline soft and blazing at the edges. The hall's every carved relief stands out in sharp relief-shadow against the flooding white, the air between the light-columns trembles with visible heat-distortion, and motes of gold dust spiral downward through the beams in slow, weightless descent.

Shadow-Mage — AURA PULSE WRAP: A single overwhelming pulse of absolute-black shadow-aura detonates outward from the shadow-mage's chest and floods the entire chamber, the darkness not extinguishing the hall's light but layering over it in deep violet-black saturation that renders every surface in deep shadow-velvet. The shadow-mage is at the pulse's origin, suspended slightly off the floor by the aura's force, robes flared outward in a perfect radial bloom, fingers splayed wide, face half-consumed by the shadow that pours outward from behind his eyes. The hall's torches burn on inside the aura but cast violet-edged shadows that point inward toward the caster rather than away, the vaulted ceiling collects the aura in thick drifting dark-cloud banks, and the air between caster and wall is visible as layered curtains of moving shadow.

Fey-Witch — CHAOS-RIBBONS PRISMATIC SWIRL: Silver-white and rose-gold fey-light ribbons unspool from the fey-witch in dozens of looping arcs, each ribbon six inches wide and ten meters long, the full collection filling the hall in a wild three-dimensional weave of intersecting light-paths that pulse and breathe as they move. She spins slowly at the weave's center, one arm overhead and one trailing, her layered gossamer robes already torn to long strips that merge visually with the ribbons, her loose hair indistinguishable from the light-streamers flowing around her. Every mirrored and polished surface in the hall — brass fittings, marble inlays, the dark water pooled in the floor's cistern-channels — reflects the weave back inward, doubling the saturation, and the stone ceiling collects the ribbon-light in shifting rose-silver aurora patterns.

Druid — ELEMENTAL ERUPTION VERDANT: A violent eruption of living verdant-green energy tears upward from the hall floor, massive root-and-vine shapes made of pure emerald spell-light cracking through the stone paving and driving toward the ceiling, each one the width of a man's torso and branching at the apex into canopy-spreads of light-leaves. The druid is gripped at the eruption's base, his body enveloped by the rising green energy, robes pressed flat against his form by the upward rush, both arms raised along his sides as if surfing the surge, his face lit solid green from the spell-light inches away. Every wall-surface is coated in projected leaf-shadow patterns that shift as the light-branches sway, the ceiling's old stone crumbles at its joints where the spell-light canopy presses, and the air is saturated with the smell of deep forest and the glow of a thousand bioluminescent motes.

Chronomancer — ARCANE VORTEX TEMPORAL: A time-vortex rips open in the hall's upper third and funnels downward in a cone, its surface showing fragmented glimpses of other moments — the same hall empty, burning, ancient — layered in translucent overlapping temporal-light, the cone's mouth spanning the entire ceiling width. The chronomancer stands at the cone's narrow point of contact with the floor, both arms raised into the funnel, her grey robes cycling through visible aging and restoration in rapid waves as time-current washes over her, her face caught between expressions that flicker with the spell's temporal fluctuations. The hall's columns exist simultaneously as intact, cracked, and restored within the vortex's influence zone, the floor beneath the chronomancer's feet is a compressed record of every scratch and stain it ever carried, and sand from no visible source rains upward into the funnel in a continuous golden stream.

Blood-Mage — SUMMONING-CIRCLE CRIMSON: A vast blood-ritual circle blazes across the entire hall floor in deep arterial crimson, its complex intersecting rings and sacrifice-glyphs pulsing in a slow heartbeat rhythm, columns of dark red fel-light rising from the twelve outer anchor-points like smoking pillars. The blood-mage stands at the innermost ring with both arms spread and tilted slightly downward, the crimson current of the circle visibly flowing upward through her body from the soles of her feet to the top of her skull, her black robes soaked in refracted red, her face caught in the effort of containing the spell's pull. The hall's white stone walls are washed entirely crimson, every carved face in the decorative friezes appears to weep with reflected light, and the air carries a metallic heaviness that makes the torchflames burn copper rather than gold.

Mage — ARTIFACT ORBITAL STORM: Every tome, scroll, crystal orb, astrolabe, and brass instrument in the hall has been ripped from its shelf and shelf-bracket and launched into a dense orbiting constellation that fills the entire upper two-thirds of the room, the objects cycling in layered rings around a shared axis while blue-white arcane light connects each to the next in luminous tethers. The mage floats at the constellation's central axis, cross-legged and suspended three meters off the floor, robes drifting upward in the magical current, his hands cupping a sphere of compressed white arcane fire that powers the entire orbital system. The hall's emptied shelves expose raw stone that pulses with residual blue light, the ceiling's plaster has shed in large sheets from the repeated passage of orbiting objects, and every tether-line between artifacts throws a blade-thin stripe of blue light across every surface.

Hedgewitch — RUNIC STORM LEAF-SCRIPT: A storm of carved-bone and green-wood rune-chips erupts outward from the hedgewitch in an expanding sphere, each chip tumbling and trailing green light as it spirals outward, the full swarm filling the hall in a dense cloud of thousands of rotating, glowing script-fragments. The hedgewitch is at the swarm's origin, completely hidden inside the densest inner layer, only the silhouette of her form visible through the cloud, her arms spread, her wide-brimmed hat ripped free and spinning outward with the rune-chips, her braid lifting horizontal in the magical wind. The hall's old oak furniture is pitted and carved by passing chips, the floor is sheeted in a moving carpet of projected green rune-shadows, and the timber rafters overhead are laced with hundreds of chips that have embedded themselves in the wood and continue to glow.

Sorcerer — ELEMENTAL FROST ERUPTION: A catastrophic frost-blast detonates outward from the sorcerer's raised palms, white-blue cold-energy expanding to fill the entire hall in a dense crackling blizzard of magical frost, ice-crystal formations blooming on every surface simultaneously in fractal patterns that glow with interior blue-white light. The sorcerer is inside the blast's origin-zone, coat frozen stiff in mid-billow around him, hair crystallized upright in white frost-glass, his breath a continuous plume of icy vapor that feeds the expanding storm, his form barely legible inside the white-out of magical blizzard. Every column is sheathed in a thick sleeve of glowing ice from floor to capital, the vaulted ceiling drips with hundreds of growing stalactite-icicles that chime against each other in the magical wind, and the hall's floor is a smooth mirror of transparent magical ice through which the old stone paving is visible several inches below.

Archmage — PORTAL RIFT BLOOM PLANAR: A colossal circular plane-rift tears open to occupy the entire rear wall of the hall, its circumference crackling with silver-white energy while through its surface a completely alien sky — vast and deep void-blue with slowly rotating stellar structures — pours light of impossible clarity into the chamber. The archmage stands before it with arms outstretched at shoulder height, back to the viewer, his robes pressed flat forward by the rift's outflow, his white hair drawn backward in two horizontal streams, his silhouette reduced to a dark mark against the overwhelming planar luminescence. The hall's rear columns are partially dematerialized where the rift's edge cuts through them, the floor between archmage and rift is scattered with objects drawn from the other side — stones, leaves, crystalline forms — and the ceiling collects the planar light in shifting aurora patterns of blue and silver.

Warlock — AURA PULSE FEL-WRAP: A room-saturating pulse of deep violet fel-energy rolls outward from the warlock in a sustained wave that doesn't dissipate but builds, the entire hall filled floor-to-ceiling with churning violet luminescence so dense it renders the far walls as dark smears behind layers of glowing haze. The warlock stands at the fel-aura's anchor point, chain-wrapped hands raised to either side of his skull, his patron's mark blazing through the back of his coat in violet fire, his form at the center of the darkest-brightest convergence of competing light-layers. Fel-green fire ignites spontaneously in every torch and brazier in the hall, burning violet at the base and transitioning to sickly yellow at the tip, the floor's old mortar lines glow violet as the energy flows through them in the building's original foundation geometry, and the air is thick with churning motes of dark energy.

Battle-Mage — SPELL-CIRCLE COMBAT BLOOM: A combat spell-circle blazes into existence across the entire hall floor and walls simultaneously — not merely horizontal but a full spherical geometric pattern that wraps every surface in blazing red-gold runes, the hall becoming the interior of a vast arcane weapon. The battle-mage is at the sphere's center, sword planted vertically before her as the circle's anchor, both hands gripping the hilt, the red-gold geometric light pouring upward along the blade and then flooding outward from its tip in a dome, her armor entirely obscured by the overlay of rune-light wrapping her form. The hall shakes with a bass resonance as the circle's power builds, every loose stone and fragment of mortar rising three inches off the floor and hovering, and every column glows internally as though the stone itself has absorbed the red-gold energy and is radiating it back.

Necromancer — RUNIC STORM DEATH-GLYPH: A death-glyph cascade erupts in a hundred-meter radius, bone-white script and grey-black necrotic symbols flooding outward from the necromancer in a horizontal blizzard, the symbols growing as they travel and stacking in overlapping planes throughout the hall's full volume. The necromancer is the storm's silent eye, standing with arms lowered and palms forward in a pushing gesture, his deep-cowled robes whipping vertically upward from the force of the outward cascade, the glyph-storm passing so close it carves hairline marks in the exposed skin of his hands. The hall's carved stone effigies and memorial reliefs are covered in projected glyph-text that makes them appear to be inscribed with new messages, the floor between the flying symbols is dark but shot through with grey-white light where glyphs skim its surface, and the air carries a deep cold that drops temperature visibly as the glyphs' necrotic resonance saturates the space.
